_what: Task deaths that have been diagnosed and ruled on. An entry here is rendered in the digest's watchdog section and dispatches NO alert, so a death that has already been explained stops re-firing without the tripwire going blind to it (PROP-11).
_matching: All three of task, result_code and recorded_at must match for an entry to apply. recorded_at is the instant Windows Task Scheduler recorded, naive and in the host's local wall clock, exactly as it appears in the digest. A ledger keyed on the task alone would also mute that task's NEXT death, which is the failure this file must not become.
_adding: Add an entry only after the death has a dated ruling in docs/decisions.md, and name that ruling in `ruling`.

acknowledged.ruling: 2026-08-30 ruling — the Glass Box refresh died after writing its snapshot (ERROR_PROCESS_ABORTED); diagnosed, pre-hardening, and the incident this tripwire was built for
